answer_1.quote: MIND instructs Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to generate purchase intentions in a three-step manner...

answer_3.quote: We instruct the LVLM to assume the role of an E-commerce customer and provide it with a generated intention... ask it to first determine whether the intention successfully motivates the purchase behavior...

answer_4.quote: We hire human annotators from the Amazon Mechanical Turk service to evaluate the generated intentions.
answer_4.guideline: For a generated intention, we task each worker to evaluate four aspects: Plausibility, Typicality, Human-centric, and Filter rationale as binary classification tasks.
